a260817p1.summary: When I wrote this week about Anthropic's announcement that all Claude models, worldwide, would soon begin “watermarking” …
a260817p1.title: Anthropic's text watermark alters word probabilities to embed a fingerprint, which could degrade Claude's writing, despite its claim of no impact on quality (John Gruber/Daring Fireball)

a260817p10.summary: Binance last year handed Russian authorities details of cryptocurrency donations to Ukrainian fundraising campaigns that were used …
a260817p10.title: Russian law enforcement docs: Binance provided Russia with transaction records and passport copies of IT specialist Yuri Belenkiy, leading to terrorism charges (Anton Zverev/Reuters)

a260817p11.summary: Investors in gigawatt-scale campuses face billions in underinsured risks as insurers balk at cost of full coverage
a260817p11.title: Sources: Meta and BlackRock's $14B El Paso data center project is not insured against total loss, exposing lenders to credit risks and big potential liabilities (Financial Times)

a260817p12.summary: Tanay Kothari saw Iron Man when he was 10 years old. — It was 2008 and he wasn't entranced with Tony Stark.
a260817p12.title: Voice AI startup Wispr raised a $280M Series B led by Menlo Ventures at a $2B valuation, taking its total funding to $361M, and now has 100K business customers (Allie Garfinkle/Fortune)

a260817p13.summary: Anyone with a stock portfolio has invariably noticed that semiconductor companies are on a tear this year.
a260817p13.title: Chip giants participated in startup funding rounds collectively surpassing $250B YTD; Nvidia leads the sector in deal volume with a record 59 funding rounds (Joanna Glasner/Crunchbase News)

a260817p14.summary: Groq has raised $350 million in funding at a $3.5 billion valuation, roughly half what it was worth nearly a year ago …
a260817p14.title: Groq raised $350M led by Disruptive at a $3.5B valuation, down from $6.9B in September 2025 before Nvidia struck a licensing deal and hired much of its talent (Natasha Mascarenhas/Bloomberg)

a260817p15.summary: Agreement with SoftBank's SB Energy caps weeks of negotiations over the largest data-center project announced to date
a260817p15.title: OpenAI signs a 20-year, 10GW data center deal in Ohio with SoftBank's SB Energy; Nvidia agrees to backstop a portion of the value of the completed data center (Anissa Gardizy/Wall Street Journal)

a260817p16.summary: The OpenAI-Hugging Face incident was a watershed moment for cybersecurity because it gave a peek into how the capabilities …
a260817p16.title: Greg Brockman calls the OpenAI-Hugging Face incident "a watershed moment" and discusses how OpenAI and other organizations can use AI to improve cyber defenses (Greg Brockman)

a260817p2.summary: The sealed complaint leaves Chainalysis' specific objections and requested remedy undisclosed as briefing continues.
a260817p2.title: Chainalysis sues the US government over ICE's $94.6M contract to buy forensic software and services from its competitor TRM Labs, calling the deal "arbitrary" (Ezra Reguerra/Cointelegraph)

a260817p3.summary: Company founded by former Snap executive Alex Mashrabov targets marketing content for businesses
a260817p3.title: AI video generation startup Higgsfield raised $400M from DST, Goldman Sachs, Liberty Global, Intel, and others at a $5.4B valuation, up from $1.3B in January (James Fontanella-Khan/Financial Times)

a260817p4.summary: Friday's big release was Qwen 3.8 27B, an Apache 2 licensed 27B parameter vision-capable LLM from Alibaba's Qwen research lab.
a260817p4.title: Qwen 3.8 27B shows a 17GB open-weight general purpose model can have long context, effective tool calling, strong vision ability, and competent code generation (Simon Willison/Simon Willison's Weblog)

a260817p5.summary: Companies such as Caterpillar and Cummins are pivoting to feed a booming market for once-prosaic power equipment
a260817p5.title: How US industrial companies like Caterpillar, Cummins, Eaton, and Ford are pivoting their businesses to feed a booming AI data-center market for power equipment (Bob Tita/Wall Street Journal)

a260817p6.summary: Amid fears for jobs, some film-makers say AI could enable them bypass studio giants and take more creative risks
a260817p6.title: AI film startups are setting up studios in Hollywood, using US and Chinese AI models while touting lower production costs and a way around traditional financing (Robert Booth/The Guardian)

a260817p7.summary: Massive spending commitments for data-center leases and chips aren't shown on companies' balance sheets
a260817p7.title: Analysis: nine top tech companies including Alphabet and Meta had ~$3T of AI-related off-balance-sheet commitments, far exceeding their $600B in reported capex (Wall Street Journal)

a260817p8.summary: Online fast-fashion retailer Shein is eyeing a company valuation of around $25 billion in its Hong Kong IPO …
a260817p8.title: Sources: Singapore-based Shein is aiming to hit a ~$25B valuation in its Hong Kong IPO, down from its $30B-$40B goal earlier in August after investor meetings (Reuters)

a260817p9.summary: FT analysis finds 60 largest planned facilities could emit equivalent of 27 coal plants or 24mn cars per year
a260817p9.title: An analysis of 60 of the largest planned US data centers: they could together produce 101.5M tons of CO2 per year, or ~7% of US power sector emissions in 2025 (Financial Times)
